The user objective of achieving a 15.0x residence-time reduction was met by Candidate 1, which also maintained a safe operating pressure. The most important remaining uncertainty is the actual flow enhancement factor, which should be verified experimentally. The first experiment should verify the flow regime and photon penetration by running a blank solvent at the design flow rate for 30 minutes, then switching to the reaction mixture and sampling at t=3τ and t=5τ.
